content:
maya: Hey folks — PR #8124 is ready for review (migration guide + SDK snippets). Needs 1 docs + 1 eng review. CI/docs-preview is currently failing linkcheck. Who can take docs review today? @sam @ben

sam: I can do the docs content review. What's the preview URL and the exact linkcheck error?

docs-preview-bot: Preview failed for PR #8124 (commit 6f3b2a). Job: linkcheck. Error: 1 broken link -> /v1/guides/intro -> 404. Preview URL: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-8124

kevin: I can pick up the SDK snippet part (JS/py examples). I'll try to reproduce lint/test locally.

ashley: Looks like we renamed the route from /v1/guides to /guides in the migration. Quick fix is updating that single reference in docs/migration.md line ~34.

sam: thanks — if it's a single-reference fix I can push a tiny docs-only commit. Ben, can you be the second approver later today?

ben: I can review but only after 16:00 PT. If sam approves earlier, please don't merge until I give a quick sanity check post-4pm.

maya: plan: sam will push the link fix, kevin will update SDK import path I mentioned in the PR comment, then re-run docs preview. We need both approvals (docs + eng) before merge. I can merge once CI is green and ben signs off.

kevin: FYI the JS example import is wrong: `import { Client } from 'redwood'` -> should be `import { InferenceClient } from '@redwood/inference'`. I'll add a small commit with the fix and run `yarn test:docs` locally.

sam: pushed commit 6f3b2a -> 9d4f7b with the broken link patched. Triggering a docs-preview re-run now.

docs-preview-bot: Re-run triggered for PR #8124. New commit 9d4f7b. Linkcheck passed. Full preview: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-8124/9d4f7b

ben: Preview looks good from the migration guide side. I'll do a quick skim on the SDK snippet after 4pm and then approve.

maya: Thanks. CI checklist for merge: docs-preview green, 2 approvals (sam+ben), eng signoff (kevin). Merge timing: I'll hold merge until 30 minutes after ben's approval to give release-war-room visibility. If anything blocks, drop an update here. :thumbsup:

sam: approving now (docs).

kevin: approved for SDK changes. pushed minor lint fix.

ben: approving now after quick skim. Looks fine.

maya: merging in ~10 minutes unless anyone yells. Thanks everyone — great turnaround!

kevin: quick note for rotation owners: can we add a small doc in CONTRIBUTING about reviewer expectations for migration guides? Often need both route/link checks + SDK sanity. I can draft a one-paragraph blurb and open a tiny PR.

maya: please do — that would help close the coverage gaps we've noticed.

(End of thread)
